about_short_description.short_description: Our mission is to modernize how researchers collaborate and share their work — to accelerate scientific discovery by enabling connections.

product.name: Curvenote SCMS
product.description: A scientific content management system for creating, organizing, reusing, and publishing trackable research components such as data, methods, models, code, and articles.

product.name: Curvenote Editor
product.description: A scientific writing environment for creating papers, reports, notebooks, and other research content using structured, reusable content and MyST Markdown.

product.name: Curvenote Reader
product.description: A scientific reading interface that presents research articles and preprints with connected citations, interactive figures, and contextual content.

product.name: Curvenote CLI
product.description: A command-line client for synchronizing Curvenote content, building scientific projects, running local previews, and deploying web sites.

product.name: Scientific Publishing and Hosting Services
product.description: Services for producing and hosting web-first scientific journals, proceedings, and interactive articles with editorial control and scholarly metadata support.

product.name: Curvenote Integrations
product.description: Connections between Curvenote and research tools that synchronize content and support metadata-aware, compliant scholarly workflows.
